method: Transpiled the actual Terrain.tsx and Eternity.tsx with the installed TypeScript compiler; scanned every integer frame in the requested ranges. Terrain bounds include projected grid vertices, the 128-point clip silhouette, sampled ridge points, and particle polygon/trail paths. Eternity bounds use makeRibbonCells at 96 sections, sampled visible sections, and exact quadratic extrema plus stroke widths for figure paths.

terrain.intendedY: fails at top by 7.99 px due to the ridge stroke drawn outside the clip; bottom passes by 85.35 px

eternity.intendedY: pass for ribbon, figures, and rising particles
